# Skeleton trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophySkeleton | Source: Skeleton | Usage: Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Skeleton trophy is a rare drop from Skeletons in the Black Forest.

### Building

• Unfading candles

### Crafting

• Bone tower shield
• Dead raiser

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.

Categorias: Trophies
